title: RawFinding
description: The contract P1 (detection engine) emits and P2 (scoring) consumes. Deliberately contains NO risk_score, score_breakdown, compliance_mappings or explanation -- those are P2's outputs. P1's only job is to report what it observed.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this finding (UUID). Generated by P1.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the rule that produced this finding, e.g. 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'. Must exist in P2's rule table.

scan_id.description: Identifier grouping all findings from the same scan run.

name.description: Human-readable resource name. P2 derives sensitivity hints from this.

severity_raw.description: Base severity from the rule definition. NOTE: P2's scoring engine does not read this field -- it recomputes risk from context factors alone. It is retained for display/audit.

context.description: The observed facts P1 collected for this rule. This is the whole reason the pipeline can explain itself. Keys are rule-specific -- see docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md for the required key set per rule_id. Missing keys are treated as 'not observed' rather than an error, so P1 can ship rules incrementally.
